title: Assessment of Bone Density and Bone Turnover Markers in Patients With Down Syndrome and Comparison to the Ts65Dn Model
brief_summary: This study may provide information that may serve as the foundation for a larger research study to address issues regarding the causes, diagnosis, and treatment of osteoporosis in the Down syndrome patient population.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males and Females of all races and ethnicities
* Age 18 or older and current clinical diagnosis of Down Syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* No legally authorized representative (if applicable) willing to provide informed consent. Any condition the investigator determines will put the subject at risk by participating in the study.
